predecessor.preserved_interpretation: The ARN third-party-label instrument is valid; the registered deterministic narrative reducer failed. This successor does not rescore or relabel that negative.
predecessor.root_cause: The deterministic reducer exposes mostly surface-role cues and does not recover cross-domain relational alignment. The successor changes the extraction representation while preserving an externally authored label source.

accessed_before_freeze: dataset repository metadata and filename only
published annotation semantics EntSim and RelSim on a 0-3 scale
published positive-pair filter EntSim <= 1.0 and RelSim >= 2.0

external_source.paper: StoryAnalogy: Deriving Story-level Analogies from Large Language Models to Unlock Analogical Understanding
external_source.pretrained_model_contamination_policy: No pretrained model weights are permitted in v1; all learned parameters are fit only on the frozen development partition.

schema_resolution.rule: After acquisition, before any arm fitting or label-dependent analysis, resolve exact story1/story2/EntSim/RelSim fields using field names only. If the released schema cannot be mapped unambiguously without inspecting label values, terminal SCHEMA_INCOMPATIBLE_CANNOT_CHECK. A schema-name-only amendment is allowed before any label-dependent computation and must preserve every scientific gate below.

gold_contract.rationale: The ACCEPT region follows the paper's published high-relation/low-entity structural-analogy filter. The middle band is retained as CANNOT_CHECK rather than thresholded post hoc.

leakage_safe_split.normalization: Unicode text unchanged except strip and collapse ASCII whitespace
leakage_safe_split.grouping: Build an undirected graph whose nodes are exact normalized story-text SHA-256 values and whose edges are released story pairs. Every connected component is indivisible so an exact story cannot appear across partitions.
leakage_safe_split.assignment: Let h be SHA-256 of the lexicographically smallest story hash in the component; int(h[:8],16) mod 100 assigns DEV=0..59, CALIBRATION=60..79, CONFIRMATORY=80..99.
leakage_safe_split.no_confirmatory_access_until: all feature definitions, models, hyperparameters, calibration search, parent selection rule and falsifiability probes have completed on DEV/CALIBRATION

arms.P0_LEXICAL: Untrained lexical-overlap/Jaccard family; threshold and abstention band fit on DEV/CALIBRATION only.
arms.P1_DIRECT_TEXT: Direct three-way text classifier using only development-fitted sparse word/character n-gram features; no EntSim/RelSim factorization.
arms.E_FACTORISED_STRUCTURAL: Two independently trained text heads estimate REL_HIGH=(RelSim>=2) and ENT_LOW=(EntSim<=1). A deterministic calibrated decision layer emits ACCEPT only when both heads clear their positive margins, REJECT when either registered negative condition clears its margin, and CANNOT_CHECK otherwise.

implementation_freeze.features: TfidfVectorizer over pair text with word 1-2 grams and character 3-5 grams combined by FeatureUnion; min_df=2; sublinear_tf=true; max_features is fixed at 120000 per channel
implementation_freeze.direct_parent: SGDClassifier(loss=log_loss, alpha=1e-5, max_iter=2000, tol=1e-4, random_state=20260814) one-vs-rest three-way
implementation_freeze.factorised_heads: two SGDClassifier(loss=log_loss, alpha=1e-5, max_iter=2000, tol=1e-4, random_state=20260814/20260815) binary heads
implementation_freeze.calibration_grid: probability thresholds in {0.50,0.55,...,0.90}; choose lexicographically first tuple maximizing calibration exact3 subject to invalid_false_accept<=0.15 and valid_accept>=0.50; if no tuple satisfies constraints, terminal DEVELOPMENT_NEGATIVE_NO_SAFE_THRESHOLD
implementation_freeze.parent_selection: Select the strongest of P0_LEXICAL and P1_DIRECT_TEXT by calibration exact3, ties broken toward P0 as the simpler parent. Confirmatory parent identity is frozen before confirmatory labels are read.

probes: TEXT_DESTRUCTION: independently permute story texts across calibration rows while retaining row identities; E_FACTORISED_STRUCTURAL exact3 must drop by at least 0.10
RELATION_HEAD_SHUFFLE: permute relation-head probabilities across rows; the candidate decision vector must materially change
ENTITY_HEAD_SHUFFLE: permute entity-head probabilities across rows; the candidate decision vector must materially change
HEAD_SWAP: swap relation and entity-head probabilities; the candidate decision vector must materially change
GOLD_SHUFFLE: calibration labels permuted after fitting must destroy the registered benefit gate
TRIVIAL_CONTROLS: no constant arm may satisfy valid-retention and false-accept jointly

confirmatory_metrics.primary: paired exact3 difference E_FACTORISED_STRUCTURAL - strongest reproducible parent
confirmatory_metrics.uncertainty: 10000 paired item bootstraps with seed 20260814991; report point estimate and 95% percentile CI
confirmatory_metrics.domain_breakdown: If the released domain field can be resolved by name only, report every domain separately; no domain may be dropped after outcomes.

claim_boundary: A positive establishes only that explicit relation/entity factorization improves externally human-annotated story-analogy discrimination over the strongest registered reproducible text parent on this frozen corpus split. It does not establish source-span witness extraction, universal cross-domain transfer, end-to-end ORION utility, scientific authority, or superiority to unpublished/proprietary frontier models.
next_if_positive: Bind predicted factorized coordinates to exact source spans and test downstream fail-closed transfer utility on a separately frozen real-source benchmark.
next_if_negative: Preserve this result and move to a materially different learned representation (capable-model structured extraction under the independently qualified #447 interface, or a separately frozen scientific-analogy corpus), not threshold tuning on the confirmatory split.
